description: Current weather for Crosby, TX: temperature, feels-like, sky, precip chance, humidity, dew point, UV index, measured air quality (EPA/AirNow, Houston metro area), and sunrise/sunset.
name: get_current_conditions

airQuality.description: US AQI. measured:true = EPA/AirNow monitors (Houston metro reporting area incl. Crosby); measured:false = Open-Meteo modeled fallback. Regional, not Crosby-pinpoint either way.

current.description: An NWS forecast period, passed through (startTime, temperature, shortForecast, windSpeed, probabilityOfPrecipitation, ...) plus computed feelsLike °F where applicable. Full schema: https://crosbynews.com/openapi.json Adds dewpointF and humidityPercent.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data refresh.

uv.description: EPA UV index; null at night or when the EPA feed is down.

title: Current conditions
